description: This file implements backend APIs for managing WiFi configuration data within the COSA Data Model, specifically handling get and set operations for WiFi data parameters. It includes functions to retrieve and update the 'ManagedWiFiData' string parameter, with annotations about TR69 protocol compliance.

methods.name: ULONG Lanconfig_GetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pValue,ULONG * pUlSize)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a string parameter, specifically handling 'ManagedWiFiData'. It copies the parameter value into pValue or indicates if the buffer is too small.

methods.name: BOOL Lanconfig_SetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pString)
methods.description: Sets the value of the 'ManagedWiFiData' parameter by invoking an external unpacking and processing function, or logs unsupported parameters.
